Responses will be pro vided in accordance with the defined escalation matrix.” 11. "In respect of procurement of goods or services from Micro, Small and Medium enterprises (M SMEs), the settlement of invoice shall be only through any of the TReDS platform (i.e RXIL, Ml xch ange, lnvoicemart, KReDX, C2FO), authorised by the Reserve Bank of India. Wherever the Trade Receivable is accepted by BHEL, the same shall be validated by the Unit on th e respective TReDS platform selected by the supplier. The routing of invoices through the TReDS platform shall not be construed as mandating discounti ng of such invoices and the MSMEs supplier shall have the option to avail or not avail financing or d iscounting of its receivables on the TReDS platform. In case discounting is not availed by the supplier on TReDS, the trade receivables will be paid through TReDS as per the payment timelines indicated in the contract." .
